    • strokeBroken

      void strokeBroken(List<NativeEngineeringDiagramRenderer.Point> path, String from, String to, String id)
      Strokes a signal line that is interrupted where it crosses another line.

      A crossing without connection is shown by a 1.5 mm gap on each side of the crossing in the signal line, so it cannot be read as a junction. The crossing points are recorded in the layout specification as line breaks.

      Parameters:
      path - orthogonal signal path
      from - source identity
      to - target identity
      id - stable signal identity

    • strokeBroken

    • directSignal

      boolean directSignal(ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer.Node source, ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer.Node target, String id)
      Draws a same-sheet signal directly as a dashed orthogonal line.

      A final control element is entered vertically at its actuator; a function is entered from the left. Each direct signal uses its own lane so parallel signals never overlap.

      Parameters:
      source - signal source symbol
      target - signal target symbol
      id - stable signal identity
      Returns:
      true when drawn; false when no clear orthogonal route exists and a continuation must be used
